scope: Original fig167 local visible-fidelity gate only, combining one first original-pixel region observation with already observed, unchanged d505 RAW/SVG records. No new candidate view or unaffected visual review replay.

RAW167.visual_basis: D505 first actual RAW observation and its sealed item records

SVG167.visual_basis: D505 first actual saved native preview observation, not a new rendering

gate_contract.name: Faithful-source-extraction visible structure gate
requires: Visible source topology, curve type/orientation, whole source outlines, and real structural relationships are retained.
Source labels and meaningful mathematical structures, if present, are retained without fabrication.
Visible interior mark-group feature is retained rather than deleted or recast as data.
No clipping or inclusion of unrelated text/caption in the object frame.
not_a_requirement: Every smoothed SVG pixel equals a source bitmap pixel.
Exact antialiasing, scan microjaggedness, or fitted numerical radii/coordinates without source measurements.
Treating an unlabeled repeated interior short-stroke count as mathematical data without source evidence.
gate_contract.smoothing_permission_is_not_blanket_topo: Smoothing may alter scan roughness, not curve type, real contour connections, labels, or mathematical structure.

affected_composition.target: Contour shape and boundary topology versus exact pixel or curvature fit
affected_composition.new_source_evidence: The original region independently shows the closed outlines, near-straight side of the left section, differently bowed sides of the middle section, concave-sided right section, and complete widened ends.
affected_composition.prior_candidate_basis: D505 already visually recorded the corresponding side relationships, separate outlines, and complete ends as PASS for both candidates.
affected_composition.result: PASS-necessary-visible-structure; inherited prior candidate observations are not replayed
affected_composition.unresolved: No numerical radii, exact coordinate fit, or ink-width identity is certified.
affected_composition.unresolved_gate_effect: These unprovided measurements and pixel identities are not requirements of this visible extraction gate.

affected_composition.new_source_evidence: The original region shows repeated separated oblique groups within all three profiles, broadly near upper, upper-middle, lower-middle, and lower regions; some strokes touch a boundary. No label or measurement identifies them as ray paths, ticks, or values.
affected_composition.prior_candidate_basis: D505 actually observed oblique interior groups in every candidate section, without relabeling them as arrows, rays, or numerical data.
affected_composition.unresolved: Exact individual stroke identity, small gaps/connections, count as a datum, and the intended meaning of each stroke remain HOLD.
affected_composition.unresolved_gate_effect: No newly demonstrated mathematical datum is certified. The required feature is retained, but unknown individual semantics are not turned into PASS or invented data.

affected_composition.target: Newly revealed possible omission, added mathematical stroke, truncation, or wrong curve class
affected_composition.new_source_evidence: The fresh original region shows no additional labeled or measured structure absent from the recorded candidate observations, and its contour classes agree with the own prior inventory.
affected_composition.limitation: This is not a claim that every tiny stroke has been compared. A new candidate detail view was forbidden and not performed; finer comparisons remain HOLD.

necessary: Near-straight versus bowed contour sides and their orientation.
Separate section topology, closed outline sides, complete ends, and relative placement.
Any actual source labels, arrows, scales, values, or ray relations; none are visibly present in this region.

interior_marks.visible_group_presence: Required visual feature, retained by the prior candidate observations.
interior_marks.mathematical_identity_or_value: HOLD-UNKNOWN; not inferred from the count or shape of hatch-like strokes.
interior_marks.individual_stroke_connectivity: HOLD-NOT-FRESHLY-COMPARED; no pass claimed beyond existing candidate evidence.

mathematical_necessity_classification.unavailable_measurements: HOLD for numerical radii/coordinates/dimensions; no source scale permits certification.
mathematical_necessity_classification.unnecessary_bitmap_identity: Not a faithful-source-SVG gate criterion; not certified.

historical_preservation.old_D505_complete_fidelity_HOLD: Original report and freeze byte-identical; this narrower gate does not rewrite their historical verdict.
historical_preservation.all_other_prior_FAIL_HOLD: Preserved without consumption or canonical edits
